annotation_design_summary.descriptor_model: Every legal descriptor contract owns all eight fields and the full ring, states p_head = data_buffer and the CRTOS one-past-end relation p_tail = data_buffer + area_length, and uses the operational uint8-index invariant 0 < area_length <= 256 with readidx/writeidx in [0,255] and below area_length.
annotation_design_summary.helper_specs: CircularAreaIsFull, CircularAreaGetDataLength, and CircularAreaDivideWrData have callable mathematical result relations and preserve the same complete descriptor/ring model. IsFull restores the exact CRTOS KPrintf call and uses a GlobalStrings-preserving external logging contract.
annotation_design_summary.memcpy_spec: The retained original memcpy calls use an exact UCharArray::seg contract: destination bytes become the source sequence and source bytes are preserved. Branch-local assertions split the complete ring and input for wrap first segment, wrap second segment, and no-wrap; no emp/emp, shape-only contract, replacement helper, or function-body rewrite is used.
annotation_design_summary.source_fidelity: ERROR is the CRTOS xs_base.h value 1. The embedded IsFull KPrintf call is present. CircularAreaIsFull, CircularAreaGetDataLength, CircularAreaDivideWrData, and CircularAreaWrite retain their signatures, static property where applicable, control flow, arithmetic, three original memcpy calls, field updates, and returns; annotations and parser-compatible declarations are outside the operational statements.
annotation_design_summary.write_spec: The error branches specify ERROR = 1 for null descriptor, null input, zero request, and full non-force. The success branch uses CircularAreaActualWriteLength and CircularAreaWriteSuccess to specify min(requested, free capacity), exact input-prefix bytes at modular ring indices, preservation of all other bytes, writeidx/status updates, force readidx behavior, EOK, and the CRTOS full+force zero-byte write.
